compatibility.summary: Server 0.25.0 and player 0.11.0 release schema 5 video: upgrade players before publishing video (minimum source player 0.10.15). Existing image/widget publications retain schemas 2-4, and new players accept schemas 1-5 against older servers. Reviewed authenticated media delivery, bounded verified disk caches, local ranges, decoder/font lifecycle, upload rollback and API response limits. Existing code passed 228 Node, 97 Python, 33 native Java tests, API35 compilation and ten Chromium suites; clean install, typecheck, lint, build, zero-advisory full/production audits and isolated amd64 Docker persistence/backup/restore passed. Physical Onn/Pi acceptance, signed APK installation and hosted CI/native ARM64 validation remain outstanding.
